g.text: Lab 08 · Redis cache hit at 2,000 req/s, 4 CPUs, by client

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9c9c9c

g.text: p50: Redis adds 0.4–0.8 ms (Jedis 1–2.5 ms). p99 follows the framework: WildFly is slow without Redis too. Jakarta: runs 3–5.
